completion_semantics.meaning: Unmodified upstream F011 EQ-clear behavior; buffered product predicate ignores EQ/LOST and retains BUSY/DRQ/RNF/CRC. No physical-timing equivalence claim.

claim_limit: The counter compares emulated execution between byte-exact sealed media under one fork; typeone enters the existing HWA queue without paste-frame delay. Neither command is a physical-keyboard, wall-clock, FPGA-timing, or device-acceptance measurement.
